title: Exec Cadre prep runway & action tracker (scratch)
content:
Purpose: quick, practical prep notes for the upcoming Exec Cadre sync. Focus: Q2 roadmap tradeoffs, Dedicated capacity commitments, Private launch risk review, and a clean set of follow-ups we can ship within 48–72 hours.

TL;DR outcomes I want from this meeting:
- Get verbal alignment on Dedicated capacity sizing knob (tiered commit vs burst). Outcome: pick option A/B and owner for contract terms.
- Surface any late Private deployment blockers and agree on escalation path. Outcome: 2 blockers and owners, escalation timeline.
- Confirm metric set for next-week town hall: latency P50/P95, cost per 1k tokens, error rate, model-compat regressions. Outcome: owner for the dashboard update.

Top-line agenda (30m total)
- 0:00–0:03 quick context and success criteria (me)
- 0:03–0:10 Dedicated sizing options + cost/latency tradeoffs (Daniel) — ask for preferred commit model and implications
- 0:10–0:16 Private launch red-team issues + mitigation plan (Meera) — need yes/no on gating items
- 0:16–0:23 Ops reliability heat map and rollback play (SRE rep) — confirm fallback policy for canary failures
- 0:23–0:28 Product run-rate and runway risk (Liam) — highlight any reorder of roadmap priorities
- 0:28–0:30 Quick decisions & next steps (me)

Pre-reads to push to exec thread (send by EOD today):
- short slide: Dedicated sizing options + one-slide cost model (Daniel) [PR: infra/pull/182]
- Private deployment readiness checklist (Meera) [Confluence link above]
- Mini dashboard export: last 30 days token cost cadence + P95 latency baseline (SRE)

Key talking points / scripts
- On Dedicated sizing: "We can choose a conservative commit with burst credits (Option A) which reduces unit cost by ~18% but requires a 6-month commit, or a flexible tiered spot-like approach (Option B) which keeps ops flexibility but increases per-token cost. If we take A, commercial needs 2 weeks to finalize terms."
- On Private launch blockers: "Top two risk areas are (1) KMS integration test coverage gap on HSM key rotation, and (2) last-mile network perf in customer VPCs. Both have mitigations but require handoff and a three-day escalation window."

Decision table (what I want decided in meeting)
- Dedicated sizing: Option A (commit) / Option B (tiered) / Defer. Desired: pick one and assign commercial lead.
- Private gating: Accept go/no-go on current checklist or list exactly 2 blocking items to resolve before launch.
- Dashboard owner: who is shipping the town-hall dashboard update by next Tue?

Open asks (micro-asks to throw to people during meeting)
- Daniel: can you commit to delivering the term sheet draft within 5 business days if we pick Option A?
- Meera: confirm KMS test plan owner and whether we can get coverage for HSM rotation by EOW.
- SRE: if canary fails at 10% traffic, do we auto-rollback or shift to fallback model variant? Confirm action.

Data to have ready (one-liners I will call for)
- Current avg and 95th percentile latency for the top-50 routes.
- Token cost per 1k for current model mix and projected for Option A.
- Number of active private customers in onboarding and their expected SLO tiers.

Risk signals / escalation criteria (if any match during discussion, escalate to follow-up sprint)
- If KMS rotation tests fail > 2 attempts -> escalate to security director and pause customer onboarding.
- If Dedicated projected unit cost delta > 25% vs current pricing -> require CFO review before commit.

Follow-up action tracker (post-meeting — populate during meeting)
- Action: Draft term sheet for Dedicated Option A. Owner: Daniel Park. Due: 2026-03-19. Status: TODO.
- Action: Run KMS rotation tests + write remediation plan. Owner: Meera Patel. Due: 2026-03-15. Status: TODO.
- Action: Update town-hall dashboard with P50/P95/cost. Owner: SRE (TBD). Due: 2026-03-16. Status: TODO.
- Action: Prepare customer-facing comms for Private pilot delay (if any). Owner: Solutions Eng (TBD). Due: 2026-03-18. Status: TODO.

Email follow-up template (quick copy for after meeting)
Subject: Exec Cadre decisions & actions — [date]
Body: Thanks all — quick recap: decisions taken: [list]. Owners & due dates: [list]. I will follow up to confirm delivery and post updates to Confluence.

Parking lot / lower-priority items to surface later
- Revisit model quantization profiles for mid-Q2 (desktop benchmark pending).
- Long-term runbook for cross-region traffic shaping.

Notes to self (scratchy, direct)
- Call out commercial risk of 6-month commit vs velocity for PLG customers. Don't let legal scope creep in the meeting.
- If we defer on Dedicated, ask for temporary capacity guarantees for 90 days.
- Push SRE to give 2-minute summary not data dump — ask for top-3 signals only.

Immediate next steps (today)
- Send pre-read thread + slide pack: me + Daniel to produce 1-pager each (action: me to assemble).
- Ping Meera to confirm KMS test owner and get nightly run logs.
- Draft follow-up email template (copy above) and drop in exec channel.

Version history / notes to future self
- 2026-03-10 initial outline.
- 2026-03-12 refined agenda and added decision table after quick sync with Daniel.

Random scratch ideas to test in meeting (low-cost experiments)
- Offer a 30-day "trial commit" for Dedicated to reduce commercial friction (legal/finance note required).
- For Private, propose an "early access" checklist that bundles a KMS-run automation and a VPC perf smoke test to reduce manual steps.

End of scratchpad.

(Keep this doc lightweight: copy actions into Jira after meeting and set reminders for owners.)
